notes.title: 『Crimzon Clover World EXplosion』＆『Castle of Shikigami 2』NOW AVAILABLE！
notes.content:
We've added two new SHMUP titles to the DEIGCA GAMES catalog, and we hope you will enjoy it! If you like SHMUP, then you shouldn't miss out!

[b][h3]『Crimzon Clover World EXplosion』[/h3] [/b]

After one year of its release on Nintendo Switch, "Crimzon Clover World EXplosion"  will be making its long-awaited debut on Steam!

★Price: $19.99 (10% off launch discount: $17.99)

★Special discount for 『WORLD IGNITION』 users 
If you have a copy of "Crimzon Clover WORLD IGNITION," you will automatically receive a 40% loyalty discount when you purchase "World EXplosion" during the following period. By adding up the launch discount, you can purchase "World EXplosion" at a maximum of "50%OFF." 

Take this chance to experience the best SHMUPS title! 

Special discount period: December 7, 2021 - June 7, 2022

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1718160/

notes.title: Officially support "Remote Play Together"
notes.content:
Dear players,

You are now able to add a new controller in the middle of the game session, which allows you to switch to "Remote Play Together" without any hassle!

To celebrate this update, we will be running a weeklong sale starting tomorrow, March 15th.
Go grab your controller and play with your friends even without physically being together!!

All the following controllers have been verified to work with "Remote Play Together."

・XInput Controller

・Xbox 360 Controller

・Xbox One Controller

・PlayStation Controller

notes.title: Shooting Love 20XX is Complete! EXZEAL is Now Available With Contest Being Held in Celebration!
notes.content:
Get EXZ-ited! Degica Games is pleased to announce that the fourth and final wave of Triangle Services’s Shooting Love 20XX, EXZEAL, is now available!...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/465060
To celebrate, we’re holding a contest!

[h1]EXZEAL Contest:[/h1]
[b]Details:[/b] This contest is to compete for the three highest scores in EXZEAL Remix, Stage 1 Score Attack on Hardest difficulty. You may select any of “Unit” weapon types. Make sure you are set to “Very Hard” difficulty with “Save Replays” set to “On” in “SETTING EXZEAL”. Replays must be submitted to be counted. Stage 1 Score Attack can easily be unlocked by completing Stage 1 in Arcade Mode. The three highest scoring individuals on the leaderboard at the deadline below will each win the Triangle Service OST (on Steam) of their choice!
 
[b]Deadline:[/b]
The contest starts at EXZEAL’s launch, 7/14 US (7/15 Japan), and ends at 6pm PT on 7/21 in the US (10am on 7/22 in Japan).

EXZEAL is the fourth and final wave following the releases of the first wave, Shmups Skill Test...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/430290
...the second wave, MINUS ZERO...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/430300
...and the third wave, TRIZEAL Remix...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/465070/
With these four waves defeated, the Shooting Love 20XX collection is yours!

notes.title: TRIZEAL Remix is Now Available! EXZEAL Arrives on July 14th!
notes.content:
Degica Games is pleased to announce that TRIZEAL Remix is now available!...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/465070/
...and the fourth and final wave of Triangle Services’s shoot-’em-up collection, Shooting Love 20XX, is coming July 14th to Steam as EXZEAL!...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/465060

A sequel that isn’t afraid to be different. Triangle Service’s EXZEAL is the followup to TRIZEAL Remix, but it’s much more than a simple rehash. Choose between multiple ships and specialize in each one’s weapon system. Will you focus on good old shooting, virtuously patient shot charging, or dangerous but powerful close-range attacks? In EXZEAL, it’s your choice. 

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list][*]4+ different weapon systems to choose from
[*]Two-player local cooperative play
[*]Replay support
[*]Memorable soundtrack spanning multiple genres of music
[*]Includes Steam Achievements, Leaderboards, and Cloud saves
[/list]

EXZEAL is the fourth and final wave following the releases of the first wave, Shmups Skill Test... 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/430290
...and the second wave, MINUS ZERO...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/430300
...and the third wave, TRIZEAL Remix. With these four waves defeated, the Shooting Love 20XX collection is yours.
